description: In front of you on the bed is a small white finial-like piece mounted on a square base, with a dark pillow behind it. The left hand moves forward and braces the base while the right hand reaches in from the right to grasp the rounded top; together they steady it briefly as a two-hand object, then the right hand lifts and pulls the top section to the right to separate it, setting it down on its side while the left hand releases the base and withdraws.
